metadata.title: महुआ पर किस ख़तरे का साया | Threat to Mahua | Mahua Story| Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: In this episode, Shyamsundar from Main Bhi Bharat explores the deep cultural, economic, and spiritual significance of the Mahua tree in tribal life across India. Despite being a crucial Minor Forest Produce (MFP) and a vital source of seasonal income for tribal communities, Mahua is now under threat. A recent study published in Springer warns that climate change—rising temperatures and erratic rainfall—could lead to the disappearance of Mahua forests by 2100. This alarming development could severely impact tribal livelihoods and traditional practices. The video also highlights similar concerns for Chironji (Char), another important forest product. Watch the full report to understand the urgent need for action and research to protect these invaluable natural and cultural resources.
